messages:
anita: quick q — if we add a new routing rule that references quota:teamA and a scoped flag, should the console run a lint that simulates traffic? thinking about unsafe merges. cc @sam
sam: we currently do syntactic lint only. it checks schema + missing fields but doesn't simulate quota or routing overlap. that gap bites ops every few months.
ops-bot: Config lint started for anita/routes/priority-7 (job 54213) :gear:
jamie: we prototyped a 'dry-run' that replays ~1% historical traffic and emits telemetry: token burn, throttle hits. it caught a case where fallback was missing. downside: cost + noticeable db reads.
anita: can we do a cheap static analysis first? like overlapping CIDR/segment ranges, missing fallback, empty quota refs.
sam: yeah — two-tier approach seems right: fast static lint in apply path; optional deeper preview that runs asynchronously and posts results. keep apply latency <250ms.
leo: proposal: console "Preview" button triggers lightweight sim using routing histograms (no live traffic). returns a risk score + quick estimates. avoids full replay but catches obvious misroutings.
marco: risk score OK, but we need telemetry gating: only 1% of configs run the deep sim to limit cost, and admins can force. store sim outputs in config-sims bucket with 7d retention.
jamie: sample config snippet folks were testing:
```
route:
  id: purchases-v1
  priority: 100
  quota_ref: teamA:monthly
  fallback: default-model
  conditions:
    - header.x-customer-tier == "enterprise"
```
sam: UX notes: show estimated token burn, estimated throttle count, and an 'unsafe if > 0.5% throttle' badge. allow ops to approve + force-apply with audit entry.
anita: important: operator override must create an immutable audit with who forced, the preview summary, and link to traces. compliance needs that.
ops-bot: Task created: ENG-3421 add lint + preview telemetry + audit hook (assignee: sam)
sam: sketching internal API: POST /internal/configs/preview {config, sample_pct=1, histogram_id?} -> {score, estimates:{tokens,throttles}, traces_url}
marco: quota calc detail: use 95th percentile request rate per-route, multiply by median seq_len per-model; allow per-route token-multiplier overrides.
leo: agree. also TTL preview results to 7d, expose link in console + webhook callback for long jobs.
jamie: note: make sure preview sim is idempotent and safe for air-gapped/private deployments (no external replay).
anita: ok next steps: sam + jamie prototype API + lite sim, marco sets bucket & retention, leo wires console card. i'll follow up in weekly ops sync. thanks :thumbsup:
